errors.text: No cited evidence establishes that a Ti-rich L2_1 phase can be formed, retained, or remain magnetic in the specific Fe-Co-Ni-Ti system.
The claim that L2_1 precipitation restores or enhances the orbital moment is unsupported by the cited evidence.
The proposed 44 vol% boundary is transferred from a mechanically studied Al-Cr-Fe-Mn-Ti alloy and is not a justified magnetic or phase-stability threshold for Fe-Co-Ni-Ti.
